content.text: {"headline":"Forest loss in São Félix do Xingu: 38.2 ha of deforestation alerts in 90 days, confirmed from orbit","narrative":"Between 2026-06-28 and 2026-09-26, 420 high-confidence deforestation alerts covered 38.2 ha inside the São Félix do Xingu watch area. A cloud-free Sentinel-2 median composite independently shows vegetation (NDVI) falling by -0.21 over the same period. The area's alert density is 1.47 times that of its 25 km neighbourhood, so this is not just a regional trend. What it is not: these sensors cannot tell legal clearing, fire or storm damage from illegal clearing, and a drought was reported nearby during a La Niña phase. What would change our mind: a licensed clearing permit, fire scars rather than cut edges, or regrowth in later imagery.","keyNumbers":[{"label":"Alert area (ha)","value":38.2,"evidenceId":"gfw-integrated-br-sfx-2026-06-28..2026-09-26"},{"label":"High-confidence alerts","value":420,"evidenceId":"gfw-integrated-br-sfx-2026-06-28..2026-09-26"},{"label":"NDVI change","value":-0.21,"evidenceId":"s2-ndvi-median-br-sfx-2026-05-14..2026-09-26"}],"confidence":"medium","caveats":["Alerts lag reality by about 1–2 weeks.","Cannot distinguish legal from illegal clearing."]}
